title: cCell M3B Pro Vape Pen 510 Battery
description:
M3B Pro is here for the rescue. Newbie friendly pen-shaped design and 3 heat setting will help you find your favorite sweet spot. Switching heat level by only 3 click on the button is both convenient and playful. The micro sensor at the bottom enables you to active M3B Pro with on draw and no other gimmicks.

Specifications

- Size: 90 X 10.5 mm

- Weight: 15.5g

- Battery Capacity: 350mAh

- Output Voltage: 2.8V to 3.6V

Package Contents
1x M3B PRO battery device
1x USB charger

Compatible with standard 510 pre-filled canisters.
